title: Mongolian Music – World Music Central
text: National musical trends were determined in the capital Ulaanbaatar, whose politics led, in the case of the Western Mongolian ‘biy’ dance, to atypical mixings with Khalkha songs and accompaniment with the horse-head fiddle ‘morin khuur’. Ensembles in Ulaanbaatar started to employ European musical styles and instruments, sometimes combining Mongolian music with foreign styles, sometimes performing only ‘foreign repertoire’.
